meta.description: A relentless interview that asks every frontier question at once, round by round.

copy.tagline: 模拟多轮高强度面试提问
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想在短时间内接受全方位面试挑战。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to face a barrage of frontier interview questions round after round.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会像面试官一样，一轮接一轮地追问你关于某个设计或决策的所有关键问题，直到双方达成共识。它会把问题组织成决策树，每轮只问当前可以回答的问题，并给出推荐答案。
howto.when: 当你需要深入探讨一个复杂设计或决策，希望 Claude 系统性地帮你梳理所有分支问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我梳理这个新产品的设计决策树。
我们讨论一下这个架构方案，把所有未决问题都列出来。
say.note: Claude 会逐轮追问，直到所有分支都被覆盖。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will interview you relentlessly, round by round, asking all frontier questions about a design or decision until a shared understanding is reached. It maps the discussion as a design tree, asking only questions whose prerequisites are settled, and gives recommended answers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to deeply explore a complex design or decision, and want Claude to systematically uncover all branching questions.

say_en.text: Help me map the decision tree for this new product.
say_en.note: Claude will start the first round, listing all currently answerable questions.

say_en.text: Let's discuss this architecture plan and surface all open issues.
say_en.note: Claude will ask round by round until every branch is visited.
